facts.t: Woodrow Wilson coined the phrase before he was President
facts.d: Congress in session is Congress on public exhibition, whilst Congress in committee rooms is Congress at work — written in his 1885 study Congressional Government, decades before he entered the White House. It remains the best one-line defence of committee scrutiny.

facts.t: One committee met 78 times over two years
facts.d: The Joint Committee on the Personal Data Protection Bill held 78 sittings across more than two years. It is the clearest evidence that Indian committees can do serious work — and the clearest contrast with the 17th Lok Sabha's overall referral rate of 16%.

facts.t: The Public Accounts Committee recovered ₹838 crore in lease dues
facts.d: Its inquiry into defence-land misuse produced a recovery order of that size, and its Commonwealth Games inquiry exposed the 2010 irregularities. Around 180 PAC recommendations are made each year, of which roughly 80% are accepted.

bank.q: Roughly what share of Bills was referred to committees in the 17th Lok Sabha?
bank.e: About 16%, amounting to only fourteen Bills — a sharp fall from the 60 to 70% referral rates of the 14th and 15th Lok Sabhas.

bank.q: With reference to parliamentary committees, consider the following statements:
s: The Public Accounts Committee examines reports of the Comptroller and Auditor General.
The Estimates Committee scrutinises budget estimates for justification and alignment with priorities.
Committee recommendations are legally binding on the government.
bank.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Recommendations are not binding, although around 80% of PAC recommendations are accepted.

bank.q: Which one of the following is NOT cited as a trigger for the growth of the committee system?
o: The post-1991 increase in technical and voluminous legislation
Erosion of floor debates through disruptions
Proliferating schemes needing budget and performance review
bank.e: A weak Opposition is the trigger — committees serve as an alternate scrutiny channel when the floor cannot deliver it.

bank.q: Match List I (committee achievement) with List II (subject):
pairs: 3. Reforms to the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill
bank.e: The PAC on the Commonwealth Games, the Estimates Committee on uranium imports, the External Affairs Committee on Doklam, and committee scrutiny producing the Motor Vehicles Bill reforms.

bank.as: Departmentally related standing committees struggle to build specialisation.
bank.rs: Their tenure is one year, and average attendance has been around 49%.
bank.e: Both true and the Reason explains the Assertion. Extending tenure, on the American model, is among the standard reform proposals.

bank.q: Consider the following statements about committee proceedings:
s: They are held away from public glare, which encourages consensus.
They allow examination of witnesses and stakeholders.
Their reports must be discussed on the floor before a Bill is passed.
bank.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Floor discussion of major reports is a reform proposal, not current practice.

bank.q: Which Bill was referred to a Joint Parliamentary Committee in 2025?
o: The Constitutional Amendment Bill on Simultaneous Elections
bank.e: The Constitution Amendment Bill on simultaneous elections. The Personal Data Protection Bill's joint committee sat earlier, over 78 meetings.

bank.q: All of the following are proposed institutional reforms EXCEPT:
o: Mandatory referral of Bills, on the British model
A dedicated Constitution Committee to review amendment Bills
Merging overlapping committees such as the PAC and COPU with standing committees
Replacing committee scrutiny with pre-legislative public consultation
bank.e: Public consultation is proposed as an addition through live citizen feedback, not as a replacement for committee scrutiny.

bank.q: The proposed committee calendar model would allocate:
o: Five days to Parliament and none to committees
Three days to Parliament and two to committees
Two days to Parliament and three to committees
bank.e: A three-day Parliament and two-day committee week, so that committee work is protected rather than squeezed around sittings.

bank.q: With reference to the OECD finding cited, consider the following:
s: Countries with strong committee systems show better governance indicators.
bank.e: All three, which is the empirical basis for treating committee reform as a democratic imperative rather than a procedural nicety.

bank.q: The median time taken for half the bill reports in the 17th Lok Sabha was:
bank.e: 115 days — a figure often cited to rebut the claim that committee referral necessarily delays legislation unduly.
